meta.scope: Generic (core) components of the Duolingo web app, extracted from computed-style dumps, CSS chunks and the palette. Duolingo-specific components (path nodes, lesson screen, leaderboard rows) are documented elsewhere.
sources: dumps/*.json (computed styles, rects in CSS px)
js/4779-9b5aed3c.js (web-ui class maps: Button, Input, Checkbox, Card, Popover, ProgressBar, Avatar)

conventions.colour: "#HEX (palette-name, theme)"; "@ a alpha" when translucent. When several palette names share a hex, the name used by the CSS rule is shown.
conventions.body_defaults: A missing font value in a dump equals the body default: duolingo-sans 500 17px/20px (css:app-f2ef02f8.css body); font-family is duolingo-sans for everything (css:app * {font-family:duolingo-sans,sans-serif}).
conventions.screenshots: out/screenshots are 2x; crops use rect x2 with 8px padding.
conventions.caveat_overlay: Captures include an injected agent overlay (orange inset glow at the viewport edges, a pointer svg). Ignore the orange tint near crop edges and the #D97757 / #111111 / #FAF9F5 values.

global_rules.focus: No focus ring anywhere in the button system: css:app-f2ef02f8.css * {outline:none}, button:focus {outline:none}, css:4779 ._7jW2t:not(._1ZhE5) {outline:none}. The only :focus-visible rule in all 182 CSS files is pathSections ._3DGr8:focus-visible {outline:2px solid macaw; outline-offset:-2px}.
global_rules.hover: All button hovers are gated by @media (hover:hover) and implemented as CSS filter (brightness 1.1 on coloured faces, 0.9 on white faces). Text/unstyled buttons animate it over .2s; solid/outline web-ui buttons switch instantly because their transition references an undefined variable (see Button notes).
global_rules.press: Solid: face moves down by the lip width (4px) and the ::before box-shadow lip is removed. Outline: moves 2px, shadow removed, 2px border stays. Cards: 2px.
global_rules.root_button_radius: css:app :root { --web-ui_button-border-radius:16px } makes 16px the effective default radius; component defaults (12px) apply only where the var is re-set.

Mobile profile CTA "GET STARTED" spans 506px (profile-dark-mobile#72). components.notes: Transition: css:4779 ._1VYyp declares "filter .2s, transform var(--web-ui_button-transition-lip)", but that variable is only defined on ._2O7Ua._3Ymqr (css:1008, 100ms linear, lesson tap tokens). Elsewhere the declaration is invalid, so solid/outline buttons change instantly on hover and press (dumps show no transition on player-next, while text/unstyled buttons show "filter 0.2s"). Web-ui variant names come from the class map in js/4779-9b5aed3c.js (web-ui Button class map, module 71814).
